rationale: Builds on the recurrent-tail baseline with a compact structural change: keep the reverse-tail update path staged as before, but cap only the early carry/anchor injection for non-final recurrent passes during both training and final eval. The hypothesis is that the strong late-block recurrence remains useful, while reducing over-pulling toward the decoder anchor improves export-surviving tail behavior without adding bytes or broad rewrites.
title: Capped Reverse-Tail Carry Profile
